purpose: Teach: いやー/片方/あちら/情けない/火事/外食/つまみ/みかん

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いやー、リク、お前、本気で、絶対、試合、絶対、頑張ったね
lines.en: Seriously, Riku — you gave everything out there today.
lines.style: Bright, genuine praise with a hint of affection. Fast and warm, like she's not letting him dodge the compliment. Slight lean forward.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、シューズの、絶対、片方、絶対、お忘れ?桜
lines.en: Yeah? Then how'd you leave one of your shoes on the court, Sakura?
lines.style: Playful tease, half-grin in the voice. Quick and light, pointing out her mess-up. Not mean — just keeping score.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、本気で、絶対、あちら、絶対、のコート、絶対、空いてるよ
lines.en: The other court's free, you know. We could go again.
lines.style: Practical and direct. Casual proposition, no drama. Matter-of-fact tone like she's solving a small problem, not making plans.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストで、本気で、絶対、ダメだった、絶対、情けない、絶対、ぜ、桜
lines.en: Speaking of tests — you absolutely bombed yours, didn't you? Pathetic.
lines.style: Dry, self-deprecating deflection. Turns the joke back on her without heat. Light and knowing, like he's poking at something she already knows.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、近所で、本気で、絶対、火事、絶対、あったの、絶対、ニュースで見たよ
lines.en: Did you see on the news there was a fire in the neighbourhood?
lines.style: Shift to something heavier. Quieter, more observant. Slight pause before speaking, like she's moving to a real thing between them.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、今日、本気で、絶対、外食、絶対、しようぜ、桜
lines.en: Hey, let's grab something to eat outside today. Come on.
lines.style: Lighter again, almost eager. Soft pitch up at the end. Invitation without pressure — he genuinely wants her company.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、文化祭の、本気で、絶対、つまみ、絶対、屋台、絶対、ウマかったよね
lines.en: Remember those snacks from the festival? God, they were so good.
lines.style: Warm nostalgia in the voice. Slightly slower, savoring the memory. Small smile underneath — sharing something good between them.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、母さんの、本気で、絶対、みかん、絶対、ケーキ、絶対、ウマかったぜ、桜
lines.en: Your mom's mandarin cake was incredible, though. Really.
lines.style: Sincere praise, quieter than his teasing. Genuine appreciation without exaggeration. Tender underneath — he means it.
